title: Blessings and more blessings overtake me

lines.text: Blessings and more blessings overtake me,
All of His commandments I observe,
While my soul doth prosper in the knowledge,
Of Jesus Christ my Lord the Living Word.
That's what I have, that's who I am,
I'm a child from out of Abraham,
Because of Christ I'm arrayed in light in Him,
That's what I have, that's who I am.
Blessed have I been in the city,
And blessed have I been in the field,
The Lord has commanded only blessings,
It's my Fathers pleasure and His will.
He blesses everything I set my hands to,
My enemies run from me seven ways,
The Lord has opened to me His good treasure,
While I observe and do what Jesus says.
